scenario.name: DHCP allocation failure
scenario.description: The Bengaluru user DHCP scope is exhausted and new clients receive no address.

incident.title: New laptops in Bengaluru cannot obtain an IP address
incident.description: Recently connected laptops in Bengaluru show a self-assigned address; existing users are unaffected.

ground_truth.root_cause: DHCP pool DHCP-BLR-USERS on DC1-SRV-DHCP-01 is exhausted: all 50 addresses are leased and two are held in conflict state after DHCPDECLINE.
